# update gojq

Pin `gojq` at v0.12.7 in the Go toolset. `gojq` is a pure-Go implementation of `jq` kept next to Homebrew's `jq` (the host Brewfiles install the latter); the tools are installed by `go generate` over [tools.go](../../toolset/tools.go) from the versions pinned in [toolset/go.mod](../../toolset/go.mod), so the upgrade is a change of that pin. The release notes are the [v0.12.7 tag](https://github.com/itchyny/gojq/releases/tag/v0.12.7).
